GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 413.684 (18 Jan 50) CCS
(SCAPIN-2075/1)
APO 500
7 August 1951
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
Subject : Radar Policy
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG 413.684 (18 Jan 50) CCS, SCAPIN 2075, Subj: Radar Policy, 18 January 1950.
2. Paragraph 2a is amended to include the following sub-paragraph: (5) Radar required for marine navigational use.
3. Paragraph 2b is rescinded in its entirety.
4. Paragraph 3a is hereby amended to read as follows:
a. Research, development, design, manufacture, importation, possession, use, installation, sale and exportation of radar intended for fire control, fighter director and air search and including radar employing altitude determining features, rapid position calculating devices for directing fire power and such features which permit radar to be used in aircraft.
5. Direct communication within the scope of this memorandum is authorized between the Ministry of International Trade and Industry and Civil Communications Section and other interested staff sections, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.Bush
Brigadier General, USA,
Adjutant General.
